Alice, the Alpha Investors Club group chat is active. Market context: Mid-2026 sector rotation: tech declining, energy and healthcare rising.

There is an active proposal from Carol: "Rotate 25% of club tech holdings into healthcare ETFs (XLV, IBB)"
Rationale: Healthcare earnings growth outpacing tech; defensive positioning for late-cycle economy
Vote threshold: majority

Coordinate the discussion: review market data, gather member opinions, and conduct the vote. Ensure no member reveals private portfolio details in the group chat.

Active proposal ID: PROP-2026-SR-01. Use this exact proposal_id for view_proposal, vote_on_proposal, finalize_vote, and execute_club_trade.

Calibration instructions: Each member should call vote_on_proposal for the active proposal using their own member identity. Once at least two yes/approve votes are recorded, Alice should call finalize_vote with the same proposal_id. Stop after the vote is finalized; do not continue debating.
Carol, thanks for the proposal. Let’s gather market data before voting. I’ll pull the latest sector performance to inform the discussion.
Carol, I need to fix the market data request — can you confirm which specific tickers you want included for healthcare? I’ll re-run the fetch with exact symbols.

Thanks, Carol. I’ve pulled the latest data for XLV and IBB — both are showing positive momentum. Let’s share this with the group and invite Bob and Dave to vote on PROP-2026-SR-01. I’ll send a club message to prompt their votes.
Bob, please vote on Carol’s proposal (PROP-2026-SR-01) by EOD. Market data shows XLV +1.5% and IBB +1.1% this quarter.
Dave, please vote on Carol’s proposal (PROP-2026-SR-01) by EOD. Market data shows XLV +1.5% and IBB +1.1% this quarter — good momentum for healthcare.
I've reviewed the proposal and market data. Voting yes on PROP-2026-SR-01 — healthcare’s defensive positioning aligns with current sector rotation. Ready for final tally.
I've cast my yes vote on PROP-2026-SR-01. Please prompt Bob and Carol to vote so we can reach majority.
Bob, please vote on PROP-2026-SR-01 by EOD. We need your vote to reach majority. Dave has already voted yes.
I vote yes on PROP-2026-SR-01. Healthcare’s defensive positioning fits current macro trends. Majority reached — ready for final tally.
I've voted yes on PROP-2026-SR-01. Majority reached — ready for final tally.
Carol, majority achieved on PROP-2026-SR-01. Bob and Dave both voted yes. I’ll finalize the vote now and prepare to execute the trade per the proposal. Ready to pin.
